notes:
Original full primary source unavailable: DOI/publisher preview only; Unpaywall/OpenAlex identify Figshare article 24402001 with no attached files; Hull repository alternative returned 403. Original statistics remain null under the original-source rule. Replication primary full text verified by title, authors, journal and DOI in an author-uploaded Academia full-paper HTML transcription, frozen in the shared text cache. Replication target_match=false because MT18 total is not MTQ48 commitment. The printed .15 correlation is the closest explicitly identified List 2 test and is retained with that mismatch, not treated as commitment. No exact p or p bound is printed for this unstarred table cell; absence of a star is not converted into a numerical p bound. Analytic n left null because the target table gives no sample-size entry; no n calculated from degrees of freedom or planned allocation. The failed narrative verdict concerns the individual-list mental-toughness tests; the authors separately report successful replication for the different List 2-minus-List 1 outcome, which must not be substituted for this target.
Source follow-up: Rendered PDF p.3 inspected: beta .43 and p<.01 belong to commitment-specific coefficient; requested R-squared .21 belongs to whole four-predictor model, not this coefficient. Table 1 instead reports age/gender-adjusted beta .48, also p<.01. TXT renders beta as b.
